title: C: Custom Memory Allocator
description: Implement a custom memory allocator using a free list to manage heap memory blocks.

steps.title: Free List Allocator
steps.description: Define a `Block` struct with size and next pointer. Write `void my_init(void *mem, int size)` to initialize the free list with one large block. Write `void* my_alloc(int size)` that finds a free block using first-fit and splits it. Write `void my_free(void *ptr)` that returns blocks to the free list (coalescing adjacent).
hints: Block header stores size and points to next free block.
First-fit: find first block large enough.
Split: if block is larger than needed, carve off the remainder.
